en: Black‑and‑white landscape view of a rural scene with wooden, multi‑windowed buildings in the background, likely institutional or residential blocks painted in a dark color with light trim. They stand beyond cultivated fields and in front of a forest of coniferous trees. In the foreground, a large birch tree with drooping branches frames the scene, and a lone person sits in the grass looking toward the buildings.
